name: tsunami
mnemonic: Three drops of water rushing in from the left. It looks small, but it is the front edge of a tsunami.

name: leader
mnemonic: A person standing tall on the left, leading everyone who follows. The leader always stands at the front (left) of the kanji.

name: fingers
mnemonic: A hand seen from the side with its fingers spread out. Whenever you see it, the kanji is about doing something with your fingers.

name: flowers
mnemonic: Two little sprouts poking up through a line of soil. Give them a season and they become flowers.

name: path
mnemonic: A winding path with a splash of dust kicked up at the end. Anything on this path is going somewhere.

name: forehead
mnemonic: A flat cover sitting on top of things, like a forehead sitting above a face.

name: roof
mnemonic: A roof with a little chimney on top. Whatever sits under it is indoors.

name: trudge
mnemonic: A figure with heavy legs, trudging slowly through deep snow.

name: cradle
mnemonic: A pair of arms curling round to cradle something small against the chest.

name: legs
mnemonic: Two legs, walking. Whatever sits above them is being carried around.

name: flag
mnemonic: A flag hanging from a pole. In old kanji it was a lying body, but a flag is easier to picture.

name: knife
mnemonic: A knife standing on its point at the right edge of the kanji, ready to cut.

name: mound
note: Left-side form of 阜 (mound). Same glyph as borough but on the left.
mnemonic: A stack of earth on the LEFT: a mound of dirt piled up beside the kanji.

name: borough
note: Right-side form of 邑 (village). Same glyph as mound but on the right.
mnemonic: The same stack on the RIGHT is a borough: a crowded little district of houses.

name: turkey
mnemonic: A fat, stubby-tailed bird with a big body: a turkey.

name: cocoon
mnemonic: A little cocoon, closed up tight, keeping whatever is inside private.

name: broom
mnemonic: A broom head with three stiff bristles, seen from the side.

name: sparkle
mnemonic: Three sparkles hovering above the kanji.

name: grain
mnemonic: A rice plant whose head droops under the weight of its grain.

name: heartbeat
mnemonic: A heart squeezed into the left side, still beating. Kanji with it are about emotions.

name: strike
mnemonic: A hand holding a stick raised to strike. It always appears on the right, doing something to the left half.

name: slide
mnemonic: A playground slide, sloping down to the left.

name: halberd
mnemonic: A spear with a hooked blade on one side: a halberd.

name: overhang
mnemonic: A rock overhang; anything under it is sheltered from the rain.

name: canopy
mnemonic: A canopy with a pole on the left, like a market stall roof.

name: hood
mnemonic: A hood pulled down over the top of the kanji, open at the bottom.

name: stick
mnemonic: A single straight stick.

name: drop
mnemonic: A single drop of something.

name: twenty
mnemonic: Two hands held up together, ten fingers each: twenty.

name: stubborn
mnemonic: A person with their heels dug in, refusing to move: stubborn.

name: spoon
mnemonic: A spoon lying on its side.

name: hat
mnemonic: A pointed hat sitting on top of the kanji.

name: stamp
mnemonic: A rubber stamp seen from the side.

name: page
mnemonic: A page of a book with a big heading at the top.

name: net
mnemonic: A fishing net stretched flat, seen from above.

name: stroll
mnemonic: Two small steps and a stride: someone strolling along.

name: flames
mnemonic: Four little flames licking up from underneath.

name: icicles
mnemonic: Two icicles hanging from the left side.

name: sickbed
mnemonic: A bed with a canopy, seen from the side, with a patient lying in it.

name: pit
mnemonic: A pit dug into the ground, open at the top.

name: wine jar
mnemonic: A jar with a wide lid and something sloshing inside: a wine jar.

name: divining rod
mnemonic: A forked stick used for finding water: a divining rod.

name: weapon
mnemonic: A hand gripping a long weapon.

name: fins
mnemonic: Two fins, one on each side.

name: hound
mnemonic: A dog drawn in three strokes, standing on its hind legs on the left: a hound.

name: table
mnemonic: A small table with two legs.

name: cobra
mnemonic: A cobra rearing up with its hood open.

name: altar
mnemonic: A small altar on the left, with offerings placed on top.

name: pig
mnemonic: A pig with its snout down, rooting in the dirt.

name: tiny
mnemonic: A tiny twist of thread.

name: whiskers
mnemonic: Three whiskers, always sticking out to the right.

name: fence
note: Enclosure (not the same as 口 mouth: it is bigger and wraps around).
mnemonic: A fence built all the way round whatever is inside.

name: long stride
mnemonic: A long, stretched-out stride.

name: cloak
mnemonic: A cloak thrown over the left shoulder.

name: tiger stripes
mnemonic: The stripes and gaping mouth of a tiger, seen from the front.

name: lid
mnemonic: A lid with a knob on top.

name: brush
mnemonic: A hand holding a writing brush upright.

name: streamers
mnemonic: Streamers fluttering from a pole.

name: paw print
mnemonic: A paw print pressed into the mud.

name: crate
mnemonic: An open crate lying on its side.

name: bolt
mnemonic: A bolt of cloth standing on end.

name: horns
mnemonic: Two horns sticking up.

name: plank
mnemonic: A plank of wood standing on its end.

name: muzzle
mnemonic: A dog muzzle, the strap and the cage.

name: hook
mnemonic: A single hook.

name: servant
mnemonic: A servant bent over, scrubbing the floor.

name: clam
mnemonic: A clam with its shell half open.

name: peg
mnemonic: A peg driven into the ground with a rope tied round it.

name: bones
mnemonic: A pile of bones.

name: tanned hide
mnemonic: An animal hide stretched out on a frame to be tanned.

name: handle
mnemonic: A bent handle, the kind on a bucket.

name: tent
mnemonic: A tent with its flaps open.

name: elder
mnemonic: An elder leaning on a stick.

name: scorpion
mnemonic: A scorpion with its tail curled up.

name: dancing legs
mnemonic: Two legs kicking in opposite directions: dancing legs.

name: plow
mnemonic: A wooden plow with its blade at the bottom.

name: hairpin
mnemonic: A hairpin with a bent tip.

name: podium
mnemonic: A podium with a speaker standing on it.

name: stream
mnemonic: Three curving lines of running water: a stream.

name: badger
mnemonic: A badger crouching low.

name: rake
mnemonic: A rake with its teeth pointing down.

name: sprout
mnemonic: A single sprout with two leaves.

name: wobble
mnemonic: A figure with one leg bent, wobbling.

name: cauldron
mnemonic: A cauldron standing on three legs.

name: sift
mnemonic: Grains falling through a sieve: sifting.

name: limp
mnemonic: A person with one crooked leg, walking with a limp.

name: swirl
mnemonic: A swirl of water going down a drain.

name: snout
mnemonic: A pig's snout seen from the front.

name: melon
mnemonic: A melon hanging from its vine.

name: vapor
mnemonic: Vapor curling up from a hot spring.

name: scythe
mnemonic: A scythe with a curved blade.

name: brew
mnemonic: A jar of brewing herbs.

name: criss-cross
mnemonic: Two crosses stacked: criss-cross lines.

name: smother
mnemonic: A big blanket (大) thrown over the electricity (電 without rain) to smother it.

name: mane
mnemonic: Long hair flowing out: a mane.
